newsitem.title: USA: Total World buys long distance company.
newsitem.headline: Total World buys long distance company.

text.p: Total World Telecommunications Inc said Tuesday it has acquired Southwestern Telecom Inc for $1,023,765 in cash.

The company said it plans to expand Southwestern Telecom, which was described as a "casual-user" direct-dial long distance company, into markets where Total World has networks over the next 18 months. Southwestern Telecom is based in San Antonio, Texas.

David Anderson, the founder of Southwestern Telecom, has agreed to stay on as president under terms of an employment agreement that includes a bonus based on the financial performance of Southwestern Telecom, it said.
Total World is a switch-based long distance carrier.
